description: Cultionet is a Python library for segmenting cultivated land with a neural-network architecture. Its README describes a UNet-derived model, setup and use with geospatial imagery. Users supply appropriately prepared image tiles and trained weights; outputs are cultivated-land maps for the region observed. Geographic coverage follows the imagery and model training domain. GitHub metadata and the README state Apache-2.0 licensing for the code, while source imagery and weights may have separate terms. A limitation is that training geography, season and crop patterns can shift classification accuracy; independent ground truth is needed before using a map for decisions. The maps can support food-supply, irrigation and land-use simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform can inspect results but does not implement this segmentation library. No imagery or weights were downloaded.
name: Cultionet cultivated-land segmentation
